admission.justification: The public observation and transition boundaries together prevent an installation or status read from unexpectedly replacing a running host; focused tests demonstrate the exact mismatch and preserved-file behavior.

applicability: Both public status paths observing a configured owned running host.
conditions: Compare the observed executable with the absolute contract Node path, even when the new target is already installed.
A matching or unobserved executable alone supplies no Node restart reason.
exclusions: Status does not install, restart, change settings or remove process records.
statement: Public Paseo and dashboard status compare the owned running host executable with the contract Node and report the Node restart requirement and existing explicit provision remedy without changing the host.
